claim.why_it_matters: Printed as a numbered subsection heading; the markdown leaves it as a plain paragraph instead of a '####' heading.

verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 690 (folio XV-2) prints '1.3.4 Object Time Switch' on its own line as a numbered subsection heading, laid out the same way as '1.3.3 Compile Time Switch' above it. The markdown page-690.md has the words but as a plain paragraph line with no '#' markup. Everywhere else the transcription marks numbered 1.3.x subsections as markdown headings (for example lines 10222/10226 '#### 1.3.1 Character Set', 15206 '#### 1.3.1 Organization', and 17182 '### 1.3.2 Access Modes' in specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md). So the heading is missing from the document outline. Nothing is lost from the text and normative meaning does not change, so 'structural' is the right severity. Note: 1.3.3 Compile Time Switch on the same page has the same defect.
